同窗口内完成，不新建分支、不换窗口，可一并还原工作区文件——即完整的 Claude Code `/rewind` 语义。 [English](README.en.md) | 中文 [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind) [](LICENSE) 刻意聚焦、保持极简，只做一件事：**就地回退到任意远的用户消息**，还能**顺手还原改过的文件**。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind：- **就地消息回退**——目标消息及其之后的内容同时从**模型上下文**和**渲染对话**中撤回，目标消息文本自动回填输入框。始终在原会话内完成，不新建分支、不残留副本。
- **轻量备份还原**——对齐 Claude Code：追踪写类工具编辑过的文件，回退时一并还原，已跟踪文件的外部变更也能还原。**局部追踪、写前备份、不变不存**，不依赖 git。
- **安全保障**——会话日志仅追加回退标记，从不删改；文件备份与还原经安全加固；测试覆盖对话、快照、历史与客户端交互。安全模型：[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 效果预览：每条用户消息的操作行都有一个 **↶ 回退** 按钮。点击后弹出一次确认框：先列出将被还原 / 删除的文件清单，确认后**对话与文件同时回退**——没有模式选择，也不会只退一半。目标消息的文本自动回填输入框。也可以用 **`/rewind` 和 `/undo` 命令**选择目标，或用 `/rewind @<序号>` 直接指定。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 回退历史与撤销：设置 →「回退历史」按**工作区**列出最近 10 次回退（每区独立、跨区不可见），并标注每次的结果：完成 / 部分完成 / 未完成。

- **恢复到回退之前**——只有当前会话里最新、尚未撤销的那一条可以恢复，且**只还原文件、不恢复对话**；每条只能撤一次。
- **不覆盖手改**——如果回退之后又改过其中某个文件，撤销会被拒绝，而不是覆盖你的改动。
- **可导出、可清空**——历史可「复制为 JSON」，也可一键清空；清空只删记录，不动快照与对话。
- 同一页下方是本插件的配置卡，可开关备份与自动清理。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 使用：1. 在对话中找到要回退的那条用户消息，点它旁边的 **↶**；或输入 `/rewind`（别名 `/undo`）打开候选列表选择；已知目标序号时也可直接 `/rewind @<序号>`。 2. **确认它。** 对话框列出将被还原 / 删除的文件，点「回退」一次确认。 3. 回退立即生效：对话回到目标消息当时的样子，目标消息的文本自动回填输入框——改完直接重发。 **键盘操作**：候选列表支持 ↑↓ 移动、Enter 确认、Esc 取消；确认框默认焦点在「取消」，熟手可用 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter 直接确认。
边界说明

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 使用：- **回退内容完整保存**——被撤回的内容仍在日志中，可在「轨迹」面板查看；也可禁用插件让它们重新显示（仅界面）。
- **对话无法原地撤销，文件可以**——文件可在设置 →「回退历史」对最新那次回退做一次「恢复到回退之前」。
- **插话也能回退**——模型尚未读取的 `steering` 插话消息同样可作为回退目标，不会打断当前生成。
- **回退已读消息会打断当前正在运行的回合**——确保回退的安全执行。
- **快照关闭期间的文件改动无法还原**——还原以写前备份为唯一来源。

</details>

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 界面语言：插件界面跟随 DSH 的界面语言，内置 **简体中文、English、日本語、Español、Français、Deutsch、Русский、Português (Brasil)** 八种文案：消息按钮、确认框、设置页、配置卡与命令输出都在其中。插件详情配图仅提供中英文两版，其他语言回退英文图。译文由 AI 生成，欢迎母语者更正。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 存储管理：**快照备份**（默认开启）：用于文件还原，可在本插件的配置卡片中关闭。关闭后不再创建新的快照，关闭期间的文件改动无法还原。快照存储于 `<dsh home>/rewind-snapshots/`（默认 `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/`）；单个文件超过 8 MiB 不备份，每个会话保留最近 100 个消息组。手动删除该目录仅清除文件备份，对话回退不受影响，插件可自动重建。

**回退历史**：存储于 `<dsh home>/rewind-history/`，按工作区分区，每个工作区保留最近 10 条（可通过插件配置项 `historyLimit` 调整）。删除它只会丢失「回退历史」页的记录，不影响对话与文件快照。

**快照自动清理**（默认开启，失活阈值 3 天）：把长期不活跃的会话快照整目录移除，不影响活动会话与对话日志。可在配置卡片查看与配置（自动清理开关、失活天数），也可用 `/snapshot-auto-cleanup` 命令查看、设置和运行：

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 本插件的作用：相较于默认行为，本插件带来的变化：

| 维度 | 默认行为 | 本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 对话回退 | 新建分支对话 | **就地回退**——不用新建会话分支、不切窗口，也不产生残留会话副本 |
| 文件还原 | 手动还原 / Git 管理 | **一并还原**——写前轻量备份，确认回退时对话与文件同时生效，贴合 Agent 工作流 |
| 还原依赖 | 常依赖 Git 仓库或完整快照引擎 | **无依赖**——不依赖 Git 仓库，也不要求是代码项目，普通目录即可用 |
| 历史与撤销 | 无统一记录 | **按工作区留痕**——最近 10 次回退可查，最新一次可撤销文件改动 |
dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 原理：整套设计只有两条主线，核心哲学朴素却克制：**对话部分「只遮蔽、不删除」**，使用 DSH 原生的「隐藏 + 替换」机制；**文件部分「局部追踪，写前轻量备份」**，参考 Claude Code 的检查点语义。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 1. 对话回退：一次「遮蔽」，而不是「删除」：`append-only` 是铁律：会话日志只追加、从不改写——这是可审计与信息安全的地基。回退从不动历史，它只做一步：往日志末尾追加一条 **“空消息”标记**，把目标消息及其之后的全部内容「遮蔽 + 替换」掉，让模型和界面都只看得到目标之前的部分。

- **同一份日志**——只在当前会话的日志做简单追加，不新建会话、不新建分支，因此不会留下残留和副本；
- **标记是规范的**——采用与官方 `/compact` 相同的「隐藏 + 替换」：`/compact` 把一段历史压缩成摘要，`/rewind` 则换成一条“空消息”标记。由于其规范性，DSH 的日志重放、压缩、续接检查都能正确识别它，绝不会把它误认为真实对话；
- **替换内容无感**——模型对标记忽略、无感（实测验证）。配合插件对界面显示的处理，模型和你看到的对话就是目标消息当时的样子；
- **记录完整保留**——因为是「遮蔽」而非「删除」，被撤回的内容完整留在日志里，可审计、可追溯，原则上也能手动恢复。

text: dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 1. 对话回退：一次「遮蔽」，而不是「删除」：> **设计点睛**：整个对话回退就是**一条**追加。它确定、可审计，且因为日志从未被破坏，回溯是「干净的」——用最小的动作，实现最完整的语义。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 2. 文件还原：轻量检查点，「写前备份」：- **写前备份**：只追踪写类工具（`write`、`edit`），写前**备份原内容**，并**记录、追踪**被处理的文件——从不备份整个工作区，因此轻量；**单个文件过大（默认 8 MiB）时不备份**。
- **外部变更也追**：每条用户消息边界，插件重新检查所有已跟踪文件——命令执行、手动修改等外部变更同样被记录，回退时一并还原。这让「轻量」却不「残缺」。
- **不变不存**：记录只在有变化时发生——消息边界重扫时无变更的**不备份**（不留记录）；写前备份时若与前一条记录一致，只存指向它的链接（`ref`）而非复制内容。
- **还原准确**：以备份为唯一标准，对照真实磁盘，只动真正不一致的文件；备份逐字节存储。还原结果与备份一致，无“幽灵影响”。但存在限制：[文件回退的追踪边界](docs/compat/tracking-boundary.zh.md)。
- **安全与完整性**：路径经安全化处理，绝不越出备份根目录；符号/硬链接跳过，避免透过一次还原误伤同名的另一份文件；单个文件失败绝不中止整轮还原；备份与还原日志均原子写落盘（跨重启仍在），断电或崩溃后的半还原可续做或回滚。若快照使用了更新版本的存储格式，插件会明确拒绝还原并保持工作区不变，而不是猜测写入。

text: dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 2. 文件还原：轻量检查点，「写前备份」：> **设计点睛**：这套检查点的「轻」，来自**只记录被工具动过、且确实变化的文件**——写前备份保证可还原，不变不存与存链接压掉重复；还原时再对照真实磁盘，只动不一致的文件。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 明确不做的事：本插件刻意保持轻量、聚焦「对话回退」这一件事，以下场景**不属于它的职责**：

- **整树 / Git 级快照**——只跟踪写类工具编辑 + 已跟踪文件的外部改动，从未被工具碰过的文件不还原。需要工作树级的完整快照回退时，请交给更专业的快照工具（git）。
- **子代理的编辑**——不追踪，子代理会话内也不提供回退（同 Claude Code）：子代理运行在自己的会话里，其备份无法由父会话的回退还原，因此也不会为子会话保留备份。
- **fork / 分支回退**——DSH 已内置「在新对话中分支」，不重复造轮子。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 兼容性：- Node.js `>=24.9.0`。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 已知问题：1. **导出的日志是完整内容**——`/export` 导出整个会话日志（原始 JSONL），包含**已撤回的内容**；本插件无法改动导出。
2. **轻量文件回退存在代价**——特定情况可能无法回退所有修改（未被工具碰过的文件、超过大小上限的文件、子代理的编辑）。行为与 Claude Code 一致。详见：[文件回退的追踪边界](docs/compat/tracking-boundary.zh.md)。
3. **轮次导航保留已回退轮次**——右侧轮次导航为已回退轮次保留「未加载」刻度，悬浮可预览已撤回内容。仅显示差异，无功能影响。
4. **较远回退可能显示空白**——回退目标早于已加载的历史时，对话区会显示空白；需点击「加载更早」往前翻，才能看到历史对话。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 安全：本插件只向会话日志追加回退标记事件，从不删除或改写已记录的历史。工作区文件仅在回退时被一并改写，备份存储于 `<dsh home>/rewind-snapshots/`；还原以备份为唯一来源。不触碰你的 git 仓库，无网络请求，不访问任何凭据。对**长期不活跃**的会话，另有默认开启（失活 3 天）的快照自动清理可整目录移除其快照，不影响活动会话与对话日志。完整安全模型：[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind：A deliberately focused plugin with one job: **rewind to any user message, no matter how far back, in place** — and conveniently **restore the files it changed** along the way.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind：- **In-place rewind, no new session** — the target message and everything after it (replies, tool calls) are withdrawn from the model context *and* the rendered transcript, and the target's text is filled back into the composer for editing and re-sending. It all happens inside the original session: no new branch, no leftover copy.
- **Lightweight checkpoint restore** — Claude Code-aligned: files edited by the write tools are tracked and restored by the same rewind, and external changes to already-tracked files are restorable too. **Partial tracking, before-write backup, store only on change**, with no git dependency.
- **Safety guarantees** — the session log only ever appends rewind markers and is never deleted or rewritten; file backup and restore are hardened; tests cover the conversation, snapshot, history, and client paths. Security model: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Preview：Every user message carries a **↶ rewind** button in its action row. Clicking it opens a single confirmation dialog listing the files that will be restored or deleted; one confirm rewinds **the conversation and the files together** — there is no mode choice and no half rewind. The target's text is filled back into the composer. You can also pick the target with the **`/rewind` and `/undo` commands**, or name it directly with `/rewind @<seq>`.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Rewind history and undo：Settings → **Rewind history** lists the last 10 rewinds for the **current workspace** (each workspace is separate and cannot see another's), with each outcome marked as Done / Partial / Failed.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Rewind history and undo：- **Restore to before this rewind** — only the newest not-yet-undone rewind **of the current session** can be restored, and it restores **files only, never the conversation**; each entry can be undone once.
- **Your later edits win** — if a file changed after the rewind, the restore is refused rather than overwriting your change.
- **Export or clear** — copy the history as JSON, or clear it in one click; clearing removes records only, not snapshots or conversations.
- The plugin's configuration card sits on the same page and toggles backups and auto-cleanup.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Usage：1. Find the user message you want to rewind to and click its **↶**; or type `/rewind` (alias `/undo`) to open the candidate picker; if you know the target sequence, use `/rewind @<seq>` directly.
2. **Confirm it.** The dialog lists the files to restore or delete; click **Rewind** to confirm once.
3. The rewind takes effect immediately: the conversation returns to how it looked at the target message, and the target message's text is filled back into the composer — edit and re-send.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Usage：- **The withdrawn content is preserved** — it stays in the session log and can be inspected in the **Trajectory** panel; you can also disable the plugin to show it again (display only).
- **The conversation cannot be undone in place; the files can** — Settings → **Rewind history** restores the files of the newest rewind once.
- **Interruptions rewind too** — a `steering` message the model hasn't read yet is also a valid rewind target, and withdrawing it does not interrupt the current run.
- **Rewinding a read message interrupts the running turn** — to ensure the rewind runs safely.
- **Changes made while snapshots were off cannot be restored** — backups are the only source a restore draws from.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Snapshot management：**Snapshot backups** are on by default: they power file restore and can be switched off in this plugin's configuration card. When off, no new snapshots are created; file changes made while off cannot be restored. Snapshots (the before-write backups) are stored under `<dsh home>/rewind-snapshots/` (the default is `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/`). A single file over 8 MiB is not backed up, and each session keeps its newest 100 message groups. Deleting that directory manually only clears the file backups (chat rewinds are unaffected); the plugin can rebuild it automatically.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Snapshot management：**Rewind history** lives under `<dsh home>/rewind-history/`, partitioned per workspace, with the newest 10 entries per workspace (adjustable through the `historyLimit` config field). Deleting it loses the Rewind history page's records only — conversations and snapshots are untouched.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Snapshot management：A **snapshot auto-cleanup** (on by default, with a 3-day idle cutoff) removes the snapshot directories of long-inactive sessions, leaving the active session and chat log untouched. Configure and review it on the plugin's configuration card (the auto-cleanup switch and the idle-day cutoff), or use the `/snapshot-auto-cleanup` command:

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · What this plugin changes：| Dimension | Default behavior | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conversation rewind | Branch into a new conversation | **In-place rewind** — no new session branch, no window switch, no leftover session copies |
| File restore | Manual restore / Git management | **Restored together** — lightweight before-write backups; one confirmation rewinds the conversation and the files, fitting agent workflows |
| Restore dependencies | Often needs a Git repository or a full snapshot engine | **None** — no Git repository and no code project required; works in any directory |
| History and undo | No unified record | **Per-workspace trail** — the last 10 rewinds are listed, and the newest one's file changes can be undone |

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · How it works：The whole design rests on two principles, simple but deliberate: **the conversation half "masks, never deletes"**, using DSH's native "hide + replace" mechanism; **the file half "partial tracking, lightweight before-write backup"**, following Claude Code's checkpoint semantics.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 1. Conversation rewind: a single "mask", not a delete：`append-only` is a hard rule: the session log only grows and is never rewritten — the foundation of auditability and privacy. A rewind never touches history; it makes a single move: append **one "empty message" marker** to the end of the log and use it to "mask + replace" the target message and everything after it, so the model and the UI see only what came before it.

It's deterministic, auditable, and — because the log was never broken — a "clean" time-travel. Minimal action, complete semantics.

text: dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 2. File restore: lightweight checkpointing, "before-write backup"：The file half follows Claude Code's checkpoint semantics — **partial tracking + before-write backup, plus a re-scan of tracked files at each message**, not a whole-tree snapshot. This trade-off saves space, and it's actually more complete:

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 2. File restore: lightweight checkpointing, "before-write backup"：- **Before-write backup**: tracks only the write-class tools (`write`, `edit`) — backs up the original content before a write and records/tracks the files it touches; it never backs up the whole workspace, so it's lightweight; **a single file over the default 8 MiB limit is not backed up**.
- **External changes count too**: at every user-message boundary the plugin re-checks all tracked files — external changes such as a command run or a manual edit are recorded as well and restored by a later rewind. "Lightweight" but not "incomplete".
- **Unchanged-not-recorded**: an entry is written only when something changed — at the message-boundary re-check, an unchanged file is never backed up (no record); at before-write time, when the new content matches the path's prior record, only a **link to it** (`ref`) is stored instead of a copy.
- **Accurate restore**: backups are the sole standard, checked against the real disk — **only files that actually differ are touched**. Backups are stored byte for byte, so the restored result matches the backups exactly, with no "ghost impact". There is a l

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · 2. File restore: lightweight checkpointing, "before-write backup"：> **Design highlight**: this checkpoint's light footprint comes from **recording only what was actually touched and really changed** — before-write backup makes it restorable, unchanged-not-recorded and content-as-link drop the repetition; only the files that differ are touched at restore time.
dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · What it deliberately does NOT do：This plugin deliberately stays lightweight and focused on one thing — "conversation rewind". The following are **out of its scope**:
section: What it deliberately does NOT do

text:
dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · What it deliberately does NOT do：- **Whole-tree / Git-level snapshots** — only write-class tool edits plus external changes to already-tracked files are backed up; files never touched by a tool are not restored. For a worktree-level full snapshot rollback, use a more specialized snapshot tool (git).
- **Subagent edits** — not tracked, and no rewind inside a subagent session (same as Claude Code): a subagent runs its own session, so its backups could never be restored by a rewind of the parent session, and none are kept for one.
- **Fork / branch rewind** — DSH already provides this ("branch in new chat"); no need to reinvent the wheel.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Known issues：1. **Exported logs are complete** — `/export` exports the whole session log (raw JSONL), **withdrawn content included**; this plugin cannot alter exports.
2. **Lightweight file rewind has a cost** — in specific cases not all changes can be rewound (files never touched by a tool, files over the size cap, subagent edits). Consistent with Claude Code. See: [File-rewind tracking boundary](docs/compat/tracking-boundary.md).
3. **Turn navigation keeps rewound turns** — the right-side turn navigation keeps an "unloaded" tick for each rewound turn, and hovering previews the withdrawn content. Only a display difference; no functional impact.
4. **A far rewind may show a blank transcript** — when the target predates the loaded history, the conversation area goes blank; click **Load earlier** to page back until the history appears.

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Known issues：> [!NOTE]
> Browser diagnostics are available; see [Browser diagnostics](docs/compat/diagnostics.md).

dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind README · Security：This plugin only appends rewind-marker events to the session log; it never deletes or rewrites logged history. Workspace files are written only during a rewind, in the same pass; backups are stored under `<dsh home>/rewind-snapshots/`; restores draw only from those backups. It never touches your git repository, makes no network requests, and accesses no credentials. For sessions you've left inactive for a long time, a snapshot auto-cleanup (on by default, with a 3-day idle cutoff) can remove their snapshot directory in whole, leaving the active session and the chat log untouched. Full security model: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
